name: devbox-site
description: Devbox marketing site. Static, served from the repo root by GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --banner:js='/* Built from src/app.js. Do not edit; run npm run build. */' --outfile=app.min.js && esbuild src/style.css --minify --banner:css='/* Built from src/style.css. Do not edit; run npm run build. */' --outfile=style.min.css
